name: release-expansion-economy
description: Release matrix for effective fist power, continuous training, spin rewards, Honor, premium grants, and rebirth.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('Reset') local b=c:Invoke('Snapshot') c:Invoke('GrantPremiumFist','Celestial Titan Fist') local a=c:Invoke('Snapshot') return H:JSONEncode({ok=a.EquippedFist=='Celestial Titan Fist' and a.FistMultiplier==60 and a.EffectivePower>b.EffectivePower*50,before=b.EffectivePower,after=a.EffectivePower,mult=a.FistMultiplier})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('Reset') local b=c:Invoke('Snapshot') c:Invoke('Train','Power Bag') local deadline=os.clock()+4 local a=c:Invoke('Snapshot') repeat task.wait(.25) a=c:Invoke('Snapshot') until (a.TrainingActive==1 and a.Power-b.Power>=8) or os.clock()>=deadline c:Invoke('Train','Power Bag') return H:JSONEncode({ok=a.TrainingActive==1 and a.Power-b.Power>=8,gain=a.Power-b.Power,active=a.TrainingActive})

args.code:
local function verifySpinCreditLedger(config,before,spin,afterSpin,grant,afterGrant)
 assert(spin.ok==true,'spin action must succeed')
 local reward=config.Spin.Rewards[spin.index]
 assert(reward and reward.id==spin.reward and reward.kind==spin.kind and reward.amount==spin.amount and reward.weight>0,'weighted reward identity must match catalog')
 assert(reward.kind=='Coins' or reward.kind=='Power' or reward.kind=='BonusSpin','review new spin reward kind before accepting it')
 local expectedCredits=before.SpinCredits-(before.SpinCredits>0 and 1 or 0)+(reward.kind=='BonusSpin' and reward.amount or 0)
 assert(afterSpin.SpinCredits==expectedCredits and spin.credits==expectedCredits,'spin credits must follow reward ledger')
 for _,name in ipairs({'Coins','Power','Honor'}) do
  local expectedDelta=reward.kind==name and reward.amount or 0
  assert(afterSpin[name]-before[name]==expectedDelta,'spin reward balance mismatch: '..name)
 end
 local product
 for _,entry in ipairs(config.PremiumProducts) do
  if entry.id=='SpinPack' then assert(not product,'duplicate SpinPack catalog entry') product=entry end
 end
 assert(product and product.spins==3,'SpinPack catalog must grant exactly three credits')
 assert(grant.ok==true and grant.product==product.id and grant.spins==product.spins,'SpinPack result must match granted product')
 local packCredits=afterGrant.SpinCredits-afterSpin.SpinCredits
 assert(packCredits==product.spins,'SpinPack must add its exact catalog delta')
 for _,name in ipairs({'Coins','Power','Honor','LastSpinAt'}) do
  assert(afterGrant[name]==afterSpin[name],'SpinPack changed unrelated balance: '..name)
 end
 return {ok=true,weightedReward=true,creditLedger=true,reward=reward.id,kind=reward.kind,
  spinCreditsBefore=before.SpinCredits,spinCreditsAfter=afterSpin.SpinCredits,
  expectedSpinCredits=expectedCredits,packCredits=packCredits,credits=afterGrant.SpinCredits}
end
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local storage=game:GetService('ServerStorage')
local root=assert(workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG')) local players=game.Players:GetPlayers()
assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio() and #players==1
 and root:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio'
 and root:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true
 and root:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false
 and storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'strict ephemeral fixture required')
local player=players[1]
assert(player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and player:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio'
 and player:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'ready ephemeral profile required')
local config=require(game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):WaitForChild('GameConfig'))
local c=storage.PunchWallAutomation
assert(c:Invoke('Reset').ok==true,'Reset failed') local before=c:Invoke('Snapshot')
assert(before.SpinCredits==0 and before.LastSpinAt==0,'free spin baseline required')
local spin=c:Invoke('Spin') local afterSpin=c:Invoke('Snapshot')
local grant=c:Invoke('GrantPremiumProduct','SpinPack') local afterGrant=c:Invoke('Snapshot')
return H:JSONEncode(verifySpinCreditLedger(config,before,spin,afterSpin,grant,afterGrant))
